exhaust.name: Exhaust
exhaust.label: Exhaust.
exhaust.desc: When played, this card is removed for the rest of combat.

ephemeral.name: Ephemeral
ephemeral.label: Ephemeral.
ephemeral.desc: Single-use for the entire run. After this card is played, it leaves your deck permanently.

switch.name: Switch
switch.label: Switch.
switch.desc: Your next switch this turn costs no energy.

priority.name: Priority
priority.label: Priority +{{level}}.
priority.desc: Resolves before non-priority moves this round. Ties between priority moves break on Speed — the faster Pokémon strikes first.

stab.name: STAB
stab.label: STAB.
stab.desc: Your card type matches your active Pokémon, increasing its damage by ×1.5.

super.name: Super effective
super.label: Super effective.
super.desc: The foe is weak to your card type, increasing its damage by ×2 (or ×4 against a double weakness).

resisted.name: Resisted
resisted.label: Resisted.
resisted.desc: The foe resists your card type, reducing its damage to ×0.5 (or ×0.25 against a double resist).

immune.name: No effect
immune.label: No effect.
immune.desc: The foe is immune to this card type.

lifesteal.name: Vamp
lifesteal.label: Vamp {{percent}}%.
lifesteal.desc: Recover {{percent}}% of the damage this card deals as HP for the active Pokémon.

crit.name: Crit
crit.label: Crit +{{boost}}.
crit.desc: Higher chance to crit (×1.5) for this attack only.

recoil.name: Recoil
recoil.label: Recoil {{percent}}%.
recoil.desc: Take {{percent}}% of the damage dealt as self-cost.

recharge.name: Recharge
recharge.label: Recharge.
recharge.desc: Until the end of the next turn, this Pokémon can't play Attack cards.

multihit.name: Multi-hit
multihit.desc_one: Strikes {{count}} time. Each hit rolls crit independently.
multihit.desc_other: Strikes {{count}} times. Each hit rolls crit independently.

burn.name: Burn
burn.label: Burn {{stacks}}.
burn.desc: End of turn: 2 damage per stack, then decay 1 stack.

poison.name: Poison
poison.label: Poison {{stacks}}.
poison.desc: End of turn: 3 damage per stack, then decay 1 stack.

weak.name: Weak
weak.label: Weak {{stacks}}.
weak.desc: Damage dealt is reduced ×0.75 while present. Decay 1 stack per turn.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.label: Sleep {{stacks}}.
sleep.desc_one: Skip the holder's action for {{count}} turn. Decay 1 stack per turn.
sleep.desc_other: Skip the holder's action for {{count}} turns. Decay 1 stack per turn.

paralyze.name: Paralyze
paralyze.label: Paralyze {{stacks}}.
paralyze.desc: Holder's effective speed is halved. Decay 1 stack per turn.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.label: Freeze {{stacks}}.
freeze.desc_one: Skip the holder's action for {{count}} turn. Decay 1 stack per turn.
freeze.desc_other: Skip the holder's action for {{count}} turns. Decay 1 stack per turn.

sand.name: Sand
sand.desc: Rock / Ground / Steel moves +20%. Non-Rock/Ground/Steel take 5 damage at end of turn.

hail.name: Hail
hail.desc: Ice moves +20%. Non-Ice take 5 damage at end of turn.

electric.name: Electric
electric.desc: Electric moves +30%. Both active Pokémon can't fall asleep.

grassy.name: Grassy
grassy.desc: Grass moves +30%. Both active Pokémon heal 5 HP at end of turn.

misty.name: Misty
misty.desc: Dragon moves ×0.5. Both active Pokémon can't be Burned, Poisoned, Paralyzed, put to Sleep, or Frozen.
